items.title: OPINION | Tata Sons Imbroglio: RBI’s peculiar role
items.description: The central bank may have been an unwitting catalyst, but its considered position will be decisive in a legal battle

items.title: Binance buys $100 million stake in Circle, expands partnership
items.description: Circle disclosed in a regulatory filing that on September 17, it issued and sold roughly 1.24 million shares to Binance at a purchase price of $80.84 per share.

items.title: Dangote hires Engineers India for $16 billion Kenya refinery
items.description: Alongside the refinery, Dangote plans to build a pipeline that connects Lamu to Ethiopia as well as another link from Djibouti to Ethiopia, under plans to build 4,000 kilometer network of pipelines connecting landlocked countries in the region.

items.title: India weighs plan to let Mumbai, Delhi airports own carriers
items.description: A relaxation of ownership restrictions would allow the Adani Group and GMR Airports to own carriers

items.title: SEBI settles Hindenburg-linked case against Adani firms for Rs 1.5 crore
items.description: The proceedings stemmed from Sebi's examination of allegations and corporate governance concerns raised in the Hindenburg report

items.title: India's aviation regulator places SpiceJet under operational, financial scrutiny
items.description: Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu said the government was closely monitoring SpiceJet's operations and finances through the aviation regulatory body to ensure safety is not compromised.
